test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for toys and apparel
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations, and uses a neutral, professional tone.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote on Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a quote for a selection of products that we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. We are particularly interested in items that would appeal to both children and families, as well as some apparel options for our staff. Please see the list below:

- We would like to order 10 units of the GiggleGear Action Figures Set, as these seem like a great fit for our younger audience.
- For the T-Shirts, could you please provide a quote for 20 pieces? We noticed there are several T-Shirt options in your catalog, but we are not sure which would be most suitable for our event staff. Could you clarify the differences or recommend the best option for a general event uniform?
- Additionally, we are interested in 5 sets of the SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set, as these would be ideal for our family activity area.

If you need any further details from our side to proceed, please let me know. We are looking for delivery within the next month if possible, and would appreciate any information on lead times or bulk order discounts.

Best regards,
Anders Nielsen

test_cases.name: Super Retail - Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer from Super Retail requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and explanations.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Items for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for our upcoming seasonal promotion and would like to request a quote for several items from your catalog. Our goal is to ensure we have sufficient stock for our retail locations and online store, so accuracy in pricing and availability is important to us.

Specifically, we are interested in the following products:

- 10 units of the Playlandia Colorful Play Mat
- 15 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- 20 units of the MagicToyland Fairy Doll
- 25 units of T-Shirt (we noticed there are several T-Shirt listings, so please include pricing for all available variants: AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, and AITEM-0025)
- 5 units of the Kiddie Quest Bicycle
- 12 units of AdventureCraft Building Blocks

If there are any minimum order quantities or special terms for bulk purchases, kindly let us know. We would appreciate a breakdown of costs, including any applicable taxes or shipping fees. If you require any additional information from our side to proceed, please advise.

Best regards,
Super Retail

Super Retail
